title: The Deep Aquifer Compact
logline: An inter-system water treaty obligating a capital world to share ice reserves with parched asteroid settlements comes due during a drought, but the capital refuses because its own subterranean lakes have secretly run dry.

roles.description: Envoys for drought-stricken outer mining outposts; gaunt, dignified, holding the original signed water treaty cylinder from forty years ago.
Governor of the core planetary system; guarded, aristocratic, terrified that revealing the capital's dry wells will collapse public order.
A heavy private security frigate intercepting relief convoys along the inter-system jump corridor.
The coalition of arid outer asteroid colonies facing critical water rationing.
The elite landholding syndicate controlling the water-rich core planetary systems.
A dusty fuel station in the drought system where emergency cisterns stand empty.
A subterranean ice shelf on a frozen outer moon in an intermediate system where water reserves are held in escrow.
The floating orbital citadel in the capital system where treaty disputes are arbitrated.

public_situation: Outer asteroid belts face emergency water rationing while {role:capital_garden_trust} prepares to declare a historic water-sharing treaty void.
private_truth: {role:capital_archon} is concealing that the capital world's deep aquifers collapsed last year, leaving the core world facing the same catastrophic drought.

beats.public_change: Notice boards at {role:border_depot} announce that life-support water rations have been cut by half across the asteroid belt.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to mine and deliver emergency water ice to replenish the station's failing condenser loops while treaty talks open.
missions.private_fact: His colonies only have twenty days of drinking water remaining before they are forced to abandon their mines.

beats.public_change: Capital security forces land at {role:aquifer_glacier}, posting notices that the escrow glacier is reserved exclusively for capital replenishment.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to retrieve the original brass covenant cylinder from the glacier archive vault before the archon's bailiffs seize the seals.
missions.private_fact: The covenant was signed forty years ago after outer asteroid miners saved the capital from an environmental crop collapse.

beats.public_change: Engineers discover that the glacier's automated pumping lines have been altered to bypass outer belt delivery locks.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan the subterranean pump telemetry to determine why the escrow outflow lines were suddenly severed.
missions.private_fact: The telemetry proves the water is not flowing to capital luxury estates, but into emergency drinking tanks because the capital's aquifers ran dry.

beats.public_change: The pilot's vessel enters orbit above {role:capital_palace} where the archon's heavy flagship blocks the arbitral concourse.

missions.reason: The archon's frigate attempts to lock tractor beams on the pilot's ship to seize the covenant cylinder and silence the discovery.
missions.private_fact: The frigate captain hails offering sixty thousand credits and emergency core citizenship if the pilot deletes the telemetry.

missions.reason: Deliver the covenant cylinder and aquifer depletion telemetry directly to the arbitral bench before the assembly votes to dissolve the pact.
missions.private_fact: He realizes that if the core world is truly parched, demanding full treaty volume will trigger famine on the capital.

player_choice.prompt: The arbitral assembly learns that the capital's aquifers have failed. Both the core world and the mining colonies face catastrophic drought.

options.label: Table the covenant to force full treaty deliveries to the colonies regardless of core hardship
Conceal the capital's drought in exchange for a funded buyout and relocation of outer mining families
Broker a joint emergency compact splitting the remaining glacial reserve between both civilizations

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the cylinder and proves the treaty obligation at the arbitral bench.
resolutions.summary: The arbitral bench enforces the treaty. {role:mining_settlement_league} gets its water, but agricultural collapses sweep across {role:capital_garden_trust}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried evidence of a dying capital to court, forcing rich core worlds to honour their frontier water pledge.

resolutions.reached_by: The covenant is suppressed or the pilot accepts the archon's relocation bribe.
resolutions.summary: The capital's collapse is concealed. {role:capital_garden_trust} hoards the glacier, leaving outer outposts of {role:mining_settlement_league} abandoned to drought.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers an emergency compromise dividing the remaining escrow ice equally.
resolutions.summary: Both sides sign a shared-austerity compact. Water is rationed equally between {role:capital_garden_trust} and {role:mining_settlement_league}, preserving both at severe cost.

loose_threads.detail: Hydrological telemetry beacons on the capital world were re-indexed to suppress falling water table readings six months ago.
Deep conduit manifolds near the escrow glacier bear weld inspection seals registered to an unlisted orbital freight trust.
Water rationing coupons traded on capital exchanges show heavy bulk purchases by an undisclosed government escrow account.

radio_hooks: Mining settlements plead for emergency water shipments as local reservoirs run dry.
Capital assembly debates motion to declare historic frontier treaties obsolete.
Security fleets establish inter-system picket lines along glacier jump corridors.

voice_direction.border_commissioner: Solemn, weary, and unyielding. Speaks in measured, formal cadences and refuses to raise his voice even under intense pressure.
voice_direction.capital_archon: Guarded, patrician, and quietly desperate. Speaks with aristocratic polish but quickly turns defensive whenever planetary reserves are mentioned.
